description.narrative: Emergency installation of two generators at the Temane gas-fired power plant in the Inhambane province. The project purpose is to contribute to reducing the current deficit of electricity-generating capacity, and thereby improve access and quality of electricity supply to the Vilanculos and Inhassoro districts.
Installation av två gasdrivna generatorer i Temane.

This Draft Project Completion report summarizes the obtained and expected results in relationsto the Result Assessment Framework (RAF) of the Expansion by Emergency of Temane Gas Fired Power Plant Project, and contains an analysis of any deviation there from. The Vilanculo and Inhassoro towns and its surroundings in the northern part of Inhambane Province are one of the best tourist areas in Mozambique. These towns met major part of its energy needs from isolated Natural gas fuelled plants and associated distribution lines operated by a private concessionaire.Furthermore as these areas attract several new tourist projects, a considerable growth of infrastructure imply an electrical demand growth. In order to target the expected demand and improve the quality of power supply in the region, in September 2010 the Government of Mozambique addressed to the Embassy of Sweden a formal request for funding as medium-term perspective to use gas availability at Temane Gas processing plant for energy generation purposes for the expansion of Temane Gas fired power plant, bridging the time in between the connection of the new consumers and the realization of the interconnection to the national grid. To this end, an amount of MSEK 55.4 was earmarked to install 2x2.6 MWe gas generator units at the existing power plant as an emergency project. In 2013 EDM following Sida Procurement Guidelines issued in June 2014, commissioned Tecnel-Services Lda to perform the works. The project has satisfied the objectives set out in the Result Assessment Framework, and the secure supply of electricity through increased generation using natural gas from Inhassoro and Govuro areas has been increased. Financially however, there are few outstanding issues to close the contribution, namely reclaim of funds and review and approval of final Audit report (2015). A decision on audit 2016 should be made although it should not be relevant since the project had already ended and all the funds should be paid back anyway.
